description: Defines classes and structures for parsing bytes from a buffer, including ByteBuffer and ByteCursor classes for reading integers, strings, and data blocks with endianness support and buffer overrun checks.

classes.name: ByteBuffer
classes.description: Represents a buffer holding a series of bytes with equality operators and size calculation.

classes.name: ByteCursor
classes.description: Provides an interface for reading various data types from a byte buffer, supporting endianness, string extraction, and buffer overrun checks.

methods.name: ByteBuffer()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing start and end pointers to null.

methods.name: ByteBuffer(const uint8_t *set_start, size_t set_size)
methods.description: Constructor initializing buffer with start pointer and size.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks equality of two ByteBuffer instances.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Checks inequality of two ByteBuffer instances.

methods.name: Size()
methods.description: Returns the size of the buffer.

methods.name: ByteCursor(const ByteBuffer *buffer, bool big_endian = false)
methods.description: Constructor initializing cursor with buffer and endianness.

methods.name: big_endian()
methods.description: Returns the endianness flag.

methods.name: set_big_endian(bool big_endian)
methods.description: Sets the endianness flag.

methods.name: here()
methods.description: Returns current cursor position.

methods.name: set_here(const uint8_t *here)
methods.description: Sets cursor position.

methods.name: Available()
methods.description: Returns number of bytes available to read.

methods.name: AtEnd()
methods.description: Checks if cursor is at end of buffer.

methods.name: operator bool()
methods.description: Returns true if all reads are complete.

methods.name: Read(size_t size, bool is_signed, T *result)
methods.description: Reads a multi-byte integer with specified size and signedness, considering endianness.

methods.name: operator>>(T &result)
methods.description: Reads an integer of type T from buffer.

methods.name: Read(uint8_t *buffer, size_t size)
methods.description: Copies bytes into provided buffer.

methods.name: CString(string *str)
methods.description: Extracts a null-terminated string from buffer.

methods.name: CString(string *str, size_t limit)
methods.description: Extracts a string of fixed length, stopping at null terminator if present.

methods.name: PointTo(const uint8_t **pointer, size_t size = 0)
methods.description: Sets pointer to current position and advances cursor.

methods.name: Skip(size_t size)
methods.description: Skips over specified number of bytes.
